title: Source systems: the closed list of where an element can come from (E122)
description: A source-provenance record names one of these. An exact name is one kind of source; a prefixed name is one source of that kind, named by a lower-case suffix (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen). The list grows by registry change only; the gateway refuses to start on any other list.

prefixed.label: A managed connection, by its kind
An application, by its client id
A public repository, by its name
